title: Desired state (topic ul/v1/d/{id}/set/{out}, retained, QoS 1, server to device)
description: The full desired state of one output, so the retained message alone is enough after a reconnect. Fields that don't apply to the output's kind are ignored. The device ignores a message whose seq is not greater than the last one it applied to that output (seq is kept in RAM only, so the first message after boot always applies).

white.description: rgbw only: the white channel, 0 to 1.

effect.description: argb only. null or absent = solid color. Building blocks arrive in the Color and ARGB phase; phase 1 firmware may report effect unsupported by leaving the cap out of info.
